question: Lipidator is a nonionic surfactant that is used to disrupt the lipid membranes of cells. This disruption of the lipid membrane results in the release of all of its cytoplasmic contents. Which of the following viruses would not be disrupted if treated with this detergent?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "Herpesvirus has an envelope" -> "envelope disrupted" -> "virus inactivated" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "Hepadnavirus has an envelope" -> "envelope disrupted" -> "virus inactivated" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "Flavivirus has an envelope" -> "envelope disrupted" -> "virus inactivated" -> 95%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "Picornavirus lacks an envelope" -> "no envelope to disrupt" -> "virus not inactivated" -> 98%
CHAIN: "Lipidator" -> "disrupts lipid membranes" -> "HIV has an envelope" -> "envelope disrupted" -> "virus inactivated" -> 95%
analysis: Lipidator, as a nonionic surfactant, disrupts lipid membranes, which would affect enveloped viruses that have lipid bilayers. Herpesvirus, Hepadnavirus, Flavivirus, and HIV are enveloped viruses. Picornavirus, however, is a non-enveloped virus and lacks a lipid membrane, making it resistant to disruption by agents like Lipidator that target lipid membranes.
